human_authorization: Implement the23-joint trainer, validate demonstrations and staged rewards, then start after the current comparison finishes. Keep success criteria unchanged and check repairs/regressions.
task_policy_scope: Same23-joint trainer, separate sitting and rear-trunk leaning policies; two seeds per behavior. This replaces the earlier tentative shared-policy design to keep case coverage and GPU memory bounded.
actor: 336 sensor/task/clock inputs;128-128 ELU;23 independent means. No reference pose, case ID, contacts, simulator root pose, or frozen parent actor input.
initialization: Strictly clean aligned50Hz development demonstrations;2000x1024 CPU cloning samples per seed/task; hold out every fifth positive case for development-only cloning validation. Fresh PPO Adam state; no warm start from smoke updates.
demonstration_admission: Full20s, no latched physical failure, final5s good, zero loaded-slip or illegal-contact ticks, reachable original command envelope. Minimum60 clean sitting and8 clean leaning examples; otherwise stop and report. No failed example as a positive motion target.
stages: Wait for four128-update original/revised results, all audits, old worker exit and locks/GPU release
Capture four frozen teachers with pre-action observations at50Hz
Audit physical labels/alignment and construct training banks
Validate real reset states; train/validate behavior cloning on CPU; exact independent physical and numerical reward replay in full teacher rollouts
Two-update PPO smoke per behavior, independently verify actual actor/critic/Adam changes
Two seeds x256 updates per behavior, frozen initial checkpoints; evaluate each on all development cases at0/128/256
Report all repairs/regressions; no automatic promotion or heldout opening
stop_behavior: Any failed gate, nonzero child exit, source/input mutation, occupied GPU at handoff or cap stops the finite attempt; kill only its owned child process groups; never change the previous comparison.

resource_accounting.rendering: Camera every10control steps plus each reset; no added physics; all wall/storage accounted
resource_accounting.cpu_audits: 600s per evaluation/weight audit,900s dataset,1800s per cloning job, all included in48h execution cap
resource_accounting.initial_raw_reset_steps: Actual initial physics counter recorded and capped at1000 per process; all subsequent steps counted.26 simulator processes maximum.

reward_validation: CPU counterexamples and saved72-trajectory observable components checked before queue; complete50Hz reward replay and simulator reset checks are pending gated steps, not claimed complete.
paper_scope: Inspired by demonstration and staged-contact principles. Not a reproduction of PhysHSI AMP or WoCoCo, and not general arbitrary-surface hand-contact training.
